use default
use Raster.IMAGE

let size = 15
let trials = 1000

let random = System.Random(8)

class GRID is
    filled: bool[]
    reached: LIST[bool]

    init(p: double) is
        filled =
            (0..size * size)
                |> map(_ => random.next_double() < p)
                |> collect_array()

        reached = repeat(false, size * size) |> collect_list()
    si

    is_filled(column: int, row: int) -> bool =>
        column >= 0 /\ column < size /\ row >= 0 /\ row < size /\
            filled[row * size + column]

    is_reached(column: int, row: int) -> bool =>
        reached[row * size + column]

    percolates() -> bool is
        let pending = STACK[(int, int)]()

        for column in 0..size do
            pending.push((column, 0))
        od

        while pending.count > 0 do
            let (column, row) = pending.pop()

            if is_filled(column, row) /\ !is_reached(column, row) then
                reached[row * size + column] = true

                pending.push((column + 1, row))
                pending.push((column - 1, row))
                pending.push((column, row + 1))
                pending.push((column, row - 1))
            fi
        od

        return (0..size) |> any(column => is_reached(column, size - 1))
    si
si

write_line("p      fraction of {trials} {size} by {size} grids percolating")

let shown: GRID? mut = null

for step in 0::10 do
    let p = cast double(step) / 10.0D
    let grids = (0..trials) |> map(_ => GRID(p)) |> collect_list()
    let through = grids |> filter(g => g.percolates()) |> count()

    write_line("{p:F1}    {cast double(through) / cast double(trials):F3}")

    if step == 6 then
        shown = grids |> find(g =>
            (0..size) |> any(column => g.is_reached(column, size - 1)))
    fi
od

if let grid = shown then
    write_line()
    write_line("pictured: a grid filled at p = 0.6 that percolates")

    let cell = 24
    let image = IMAGE(size * cell, size * cell)

    image.view(0.0D, cast double(size), cast double(size), 0.0D)
    image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 250ub)

    for row in 0..size do
        for column in 0..size do
            let x = cast double(column)
            let y = cast double(row)

            if grid.is_reached(column, row) then
                image.colour(40ub, 110ub, 220ub)
            elif grid.is_filled(column, row) then
                image.colour(120ub, 120ub, 130ub)
            else
                image.colour(235ub, 235ub, 238ub)
            fi

            image.fill_rectangle(
                x + 0.04D, y + 0.04D, x + 0.96D, y + 0.96D)
        od
    od

    image.write("sites.png")
    image.show("sites.png")
fi
